sanskrit: ityuccārya paraṃjyotiḥkosāḍhyāṃ(?) paripūjayetevaṃ saṃpūjya sakalaṃ srīvidyāṃ parito yajetaṇimādyā raktavarṇāstrinetrāḥ sasisekharāḥtrailokyamohane cakre dhyāyet prakaṭayoginīm?(ḥ)laghimāmuttaradvāri pascime paripūjayetdakṣiṇadvāradese ca īsitvākhyāñca pūrvataḥmuktisiddhiṃ tathā'gneyyāmicchāsiddhiñca nair-ṛtemadhyadvāre tato dhyāyet pascimādikrameṇa tukapālinaṃ bhīṣaṇañca saṃhārañcāṣṭabhairavamvidhṛtā vedahastena gajacarmottarāṃsukāḥvaradābhayahastā ca kuṇḍikākṣalasatkarāḥkapālamālāṃ parasuṃ dadhānā siddhidāyinīvaradābhayahastā ca dhyātavyā sādhakottamaiḥbibhratī karapadmañca divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāhalañca mūṣalaṃ khaḍgaṃ kheṭakaṃ dadhatī bhujaiḥindrāṇī syāmalacchāyā raktotpalalasatkarānagakheṭakaghaṇṭāñca dadhānoccaiḥ kapālakammātulungaphalañcaiva dadhānā paramesvarībhairavānkasthitā etāḥ pūjyā vai bhairavaiḥ sahapascimottaramāhendradakṣadvāre krameṇa tuhrasvārṇā bhairavā mantrā mātṝṇāṃ dīrgharūpakāḥraktāḥ pāsānkusadharā dhyātvā tattanmanuṃ smaranpascimādikrameṇaiva pūrvavaddigvidikṣu caetāḥ prakaṭayoginyaḥ pāntu tricaturasragāḥprathamāvaraṇe devīṃ tripurāṃ cakranāyikām

sanskrit: sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīṃ kṛtvā buddhañca paripūjayetvahnijāyānigadito bauddhamantro manīṣibhiḥbuddhāya bauddhapūrvāya darsanāya namaḥ paramcakre samudrā iti ca sasiddhayastu sāyudhāḥtataḥ sarvopacāraisca pūjitāḥ santu coccaranjavākusumasankāsāḥ kāmākarṣaṇikādikāḥpascimādikrameṇāpi binduyuktaiḥ svaraiḥ sahaahankārākarṣaṇīñca sabdākarṣaṇarūpiṇīmsmṛtyākarṣaṇarūpāñca nāmākarṣaṇarūpiṇīmamṛtākarṣiṇīṃ devīṃ sarīrākarṣiṇīṃ tathāsarvāsāpūrakaṃ nāma cakraṃ saṃpūjayettataḥdvitīyāvaraṇe mantrī trinetrāṃ cakranāyikāmsarvavidrāvaṇīṃ kṛtvā brahmāṇaṃ paripūjayetbrahmaṇe vaidiketyuktvā darsanāya namaḥ smaransamarpya mūladevyaitāṃ pūjāmarghyodakādibhiḥaṣṭapatre yajenmantrī kādivargāṣṭakena caakṣasrakpustakābhītivaradāḍhyakarāmbujāḥpascime'nangamadanāmuttare madanāturāmanangānkusāntu vāyavye sambhau cānangamālinīmsarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ cakramaṣṭārañca prapūjayetanangakusumāgre tu cakresīṃ sundarīṃ yajetsivāya saivarūpāya darsanāya namaḥ smaransarvasaṃkṣobhavarṇānte kārake cakra ityapisarvasiddhipradaṃ nāma sṛṣṭicakratrayātmakamsūryakāntapratīkāsā dhanurbāṇakarāmbujāḥ

sanskrit: sarvākarṣaṇasaktiñca sarvāhlādanakāriṇīmsarvarañjanasaktiñca sarvonmādasvarūpiṇīmsarvamantramayīṃ saktiṃ sarvadvandvakṣayankarīmkādiḍhāntākṣarairiṣṭvā sarvasaubhāgyadaṃ yajetpāsānkusavarābhītikarāṃ pīnapayodharāmsūryāya saurapūrvāya darsanāya namaḥ smarancakre samudrā ityādi pūrvavat parikalpayetsarvārthasādhake cakre pañcamāvaraṇe sthitāḥṇādibhāntākṣaraṃ dattvā pascimādikramād yajetsarvapriyankarīñcaiva sarvamangalakāriṇīmsarvamṛtyuprasamanīṃ sarvavighnavināsinīmkulakaulikayoginya etāstu paripūjayetsarvasiddhipradāgre tu nāyikāṃ tripurāsriyamviṣṇave vaiṣṇavānte ca darsanāya natiṃ smarantataḥ samudrā ityādipūrvavat parikalpayetsarvarakṣākare cakre nigarbhayoginīgaṇāḥsarvajñāṃ sarvasaktiñca sarvaisvaryapradāyinīmsarvādhārasvarūpāñca sarvapāpaharāṃ tathāgandhādyairupacāraistu sarvepsitaphalapradāmsarvajñāpurato mantrī tripurāmālinīṃ parāmmahānkusākhyaṃ sandarsya jinesaṃ viṣṇumarcayetcakre samudrā ityādi pūrvavat parikalpayetsthiticakraṃ samākhyātaṃ saṃhāraṃ kathayāmyathanavīnārkasamābhāsāḥ sarvālankārabhūṣitāḥetā rahasyayoginyaḥ prathamāvaraṇe sthitāḥ

sanskrit: dhyāyecchrītripurāsiddhāṃ vasinīpurataḥ sudhīḥsandarsya khecarīmudrāṃ yajecchaktiñca māyayācakre samudrā ityādi pūrvavat parikalpayetpascimādicaturdikṣu bāṇān saṃpūjayed budhaḥraktamālyavisobhāḍhyān yauvanonmattavigrahānbāṇadhanuḥpāsasṛṇiyugmāni ca kramādanunyāsoktakramayogeṇa pūjayet sādhakottamaḥastratrikoṇayormadhye pūjayedangadevatāḥakṣarākṣarabhedena samastavyastayā yajetsundaryāsca tribhiḥ kūṭaistrikoṇaṃ paripūjayetvajresvarīṃ viṣṇusaktiṃ sūryacakre prapūjayetbinducakre yajeddevīṃ paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇīmpūrṇe coḍḍīsanāthasca caryānāthastu oḍrakeevaṃ cakresvarīṃ dhyātvā kāmarājena pūjayetsarvasiddhiprade cakre dvitīyāvaraṇe nayetpāsānkusadhanurbāṇadharāṃ raktāṃ susobhanāmbījamudrāñca sandarsya parāṃ saktiṃ prapūjayetsarvasiddhimaye cakre samudretyādi pūrvavatparaṃbrahmasvarūpāñca paramāmṛtarūpiṇīmsarvamudresvarīñcāpi sarvavidyesvarīṃ tathāsarvayogesvarīñcāpi sarvasiddhīsvarīmapisamudrāṃ sāyudhāñcāpi sacakrāñca savāhanāmparāparāṃ mahādevīṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinīmmanasaivaṃ samālokya srīmattripurasundarīmsarvānandamayaṃ cakraṃ baindavaṃ paripūjayet

sanskrit: devyagre pūjayenmantrī gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥsaivaṃ vā pūjayettatra tattvavimarṣiṇīmatepūjayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ ṣoḍhā'yaṃ darsanakramaḥyoginya iti coddhṛtya sarvānandamaye padātparāmṛtapadācchakti sarvacakresvarīpadamsarvavīresvarī sarvapīṭhesvarī padaṃ tataḥsarvasiddhesvarī sarvajagadutpattimātṛkāḥtripurānte sundarīti parayāparayāpadātpūjitāḥ santu ityuktvā devyai pūjāṃ samarpayetsundarīṃ pūjayenmantrī satamakṣatataṇḍulaiḥpunastritattvamuccārya dadyādarghyaṃ tridhā punaḥraktacandanasindūrairdravyairnānāvidhairyajetpādyaṃ gṛhāṇa devesi sarvakāmārthasiddhayecaturvargaphalāvāptyai gṛhāṇārghyaṃ suresvarigṛhāṇā'camanīyaṃ tvaṃ srīmattripurasundarimadhuparkaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhayesambhṛtaṃ saralairārdraṃ gandhamākalpayāmyahamsugandhi vikasat puṣpamādarāt kalpayāmyahamhrīberamaguruṃ kuṣṭhaṃ guḍaṃ sarjarasaṃ ghanamṣoḍasāngaṃ vidurdhūpaṃ daive pitrye ca karmaṇiusīraḥ sapta evaite dhūpo'yaṃ caṇḍikāpriyaḥebhirvimisritaḥ kāryo dhūpo'yaṃ pārvatīpriyaḥvāmena vādayan ghaṇṭāṃ dhūpadīpau nivedayetāghreyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatāmdhvastadurvāsanaṃ divyaṃ dhūpamunmīlayāmyaham

sanskrit: śālmalīkusumaiḥ siddhadravyairmāsantu nirbhayaḥnirjane vipine rātrau māsamātrantu nirbhayaḥmālatījātipunnāgaketakīmadhubhiḥ kramātśmaśāne caṇḍikāgehe nirjane vipine'thavākṛṣṇacakre'tikṛṣṇāṃ tāmabhivādya prapūjayetsiddhadravyasamopetaṃ māsāttadbhāvalocanātviśvasaṃhārasantuṣṭāṃ punaretya nijecchayādevyā lalāṭanetre syuḥ prārthanena tirohitāudyāne nirjane devīṃ cakre sañcintya pūjayetsiddhadravyasamopetairmāyāḥ sidhyanti māsataḥyābhirviśvaṃ yayau viśvacārī viśvavinodavāntrikālajño bhaveddevīṃ teṣu samyag vicintayetnivasaṃstatra tatpuṣpairjāyate manmathopamaḥkṛtyāḥ pareritā mantrā vimukhāstān grasanti vaisaṃvatsarakṛtā pūjā yenaiva pūrṇatā bhavetbhasmābhavattadā patnī ratiḥ prītiśca duḥkhitātat saurabhañca saubhāgyaṃ mahadāsīttadadbhutamratyai prītyai ca tasmāttu madanaḥ prakṛtīkṛtaḥtasya sāṃvatsarī pūjā madanāya bhaviṣyatitasmānmadanapūjā ca kartavyā sādhakottamaiḥmadanaṃ navadhā kuryāt pūjayettadanantaramnānāprakārasaṃbhinnaṃ madanaṃ pūjayet kramātmāyā sphuradvayaṃ bhūyaḥ prasphuradvitayaṃ punaḥcaṭadvayaṃ tadante'pi prakaṭadvitayaṃ punaḥghātaya dvitayaṃ varma phaḍanto ghorako manuḥ

sanskrit: nidhāpayet saptamāhe dāsavat kiṅkaro bhavetpūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā stambhayet sarvavādinaḥnāmnā yasya sa vāgmī tu pāṣāṇa iva jāyatenāma saṃyojya vidhivad dakṣiṇābhimukho budhaḥmahiṣāśvapurīṣābhyāṃ rasamākṛṣya mantravitkṣiptvā palāśamadhyasthaṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ bhavetlambamānaṃ tathākāśe śatrūccāṭanakārakamvilikhya dhārayenmantrī sarvavarṇān vaśaṃ nayetsaubhāgyaṃ jāyate tena pānīyena na saṃśayaḥsaptāhāt kṣobhayet sarvaṃ jvālāmālāṃ vicintayetsindūrakuṅkumābhyāñca cakrarājaṃ samālikhettadūrdhve mūlamantrañca tadbāhye mātṛkāṃ likhetaṣṭottaraśataṃ kundaṃ mūlaṃ sādhyasamanvitamcalajjalendusadṛśīṃ trikoṇāmaruṇāruṇāmdhyāyan sahasraṃ japtvaiva tāmānayati niścitamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā sāyātyeva tadantikamyasyāḥ prāṇaiḥ kalpayitvā sāyāti madavihvalāyaṃ yaṃ paśyati tacchīghraṃ sa sa dāso bhaved dhruvamsādhyaprāṇaiḥ kṛtaprāṇāṃ japtvā aṣṭottaraṃ śatamsā ca yāti vihvalāṅgī sādhakasyāntikaṃ dhruvampīṭhasthāne samālikhya stambhayet sarvavādinaḥsaṃpūjya vidhivad vidvān sarvalokaṃ vaśaṃ nayetsaṃpūjya vidhivad vidyāṃ sarvayoṣinmano haretyamāśābhimukho bhūtvā cakraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samarccayetagni-rākṣasa-vāyavya-śambhu-koṇeṣu yojitam

sanskrit: stambhavidveṣaṇavyādhiśatrūccāṭanakaṃ bhavetsarvavaśyakarañcaiva bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥtailasthaṃ cakrarājantu vidveṣaṇakaraṃ bhavetyadaikānte caturmārge sindūrarajasā likhetakārādikṣakārāntāṃ mātṛkāṃ tatra saṃlikhetsādhakaḥ khecaraścaiva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥajarāmaratāṃ labdhvā sukhī bhavati māntrikaḥyathāvidhividhānena sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥpādukāñjanasiddhiñca manaḥsiddhiñca dhātujamsarvaṃ tallabhate mantrī nātra kāryā vicāraṇāmahāpātakayuktātmā tatkṣaṇāt pāpahā bhavetmāsena hanti kaluṣaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ naraḥiti śrīpūrṇānandaparamahaṃsaviracite śrī-tattvacintāmaṇau trayoviṃśatitamaḥ prakāśaḥna mānasaṃ bhavet stotraṃ vācikantu praśasyateśuddhenānanyacittena paṭhitavyaṃ prayatnataḥhastasaṃsthāpanādeva yasmādalpaphalaṃ bhavetabrāhmaṇena likhitaṃ taccāpi viphalaṃ bhavetyasmāt kalau na praśastamṛṣibhirbhāṣitaṃ paṭhetṛṣicchandādikaṃ nyasya paṭhet stotraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥpaṭhitvā prathamaṃ mantrī tasya stotraṃ tataḥ paṭhetkṛte virāme madhye tu adhyāyādiṃ punarjapetcamaraḥ kṛṣṇasāraśca matsyo meṣaśca śūkaraḥkṛṣṇacchāgadvayaṃ dadyāt paścāddadyānmahābalimṣaḍvidhaśchāgalaḥ prokto gṛhasthānāṃ paro baliḥlohitaḥ kapilaścaiva kaniṣṭhaḥ parikīrttitaḥ
